segments.zh: 两年前，您在一个只有800位居民的村子里开了一家共享办公空间，那里离蒙特利尔两小时路程。
segments.en: Two years ago you opened a coworking space in a village of 800 people, two hours from Montreal.

segments.zh: 您的会员都是些什么人？
主要是为城里的公司远程工作的人。
segments.en: Mostly people who work remotely for companies in the city.

segments.zh: 一开始，我以为他们是冲着网络来的，因为这一带网速很慢。
segments.en: At first I thought they would come for the internet connection, which is very slow in the area.

segments.zh: 实际上，大多数人家里的网络都不错。
segments.en: In fact, most of them have a good connection at home.

segments.zh: 他们要找的是同事：能一起喝杯咖啡、讨论问题的人。
segments.en: What they are looking for is colleagues: someone to have a coffee with or talk through a problem.

segments.zh: 人们常说远程办公会让乡村重新焕发活力。
segments.en: People often say remote work will bring villages back to life.

segments.zh: 确实有家庭搬过来，学校今年甚至多开了一个班。
segments.en: Families are moving in, it's true, and the school even opened an extra class this year.

segments.zh: 但如果新居民整天关在家里对着屏幕，村子并没有真正活起来。
segments.en: But if the newcomers stay shut away at home in front of their screens, the village doesn't really come back to life.

segments.zh: 需要有让人们碰面的地方。
segments.en: There need to be places where people run into each other.

segments.zh: 这位男士怎么看远程办公对乡村的影响？
segments.en: What does this man think of the effect of remote work on villages?

options.zh: 光靠它就足以让乡村复兴。
options.en: On its own, it is enough to revive villages.

options.zh: 它主要改善了网络连接。
options.en: It has mainly improved the internet connection.

options.zh: 它的好处取决于有没有让人见面的场所。
options.en: Its benefits depend on there being places where people can meet.
It pushes families to leave villages.

analysis.summary: 问受访者怎么看远程办公对乡村的作用。他先说“En partie”（部分相信），再补充：没有让人碰面的地方，村子不会真正活起来。

A.why: 他只回答“En partie”（部分相信）。他还说人们关在家里时“le village ne revit pas vraiment”（村子没有真正活起来）。选项里的 à lui seul（光靠它）和他的保留态度相反；faire revivre 借用了主持人的说法 redonner vie，是陷阱。

B.why: connexion Internet 出现在他开业时的错误判断里：其实大多数会员家里网络很好。他没有说远程办公改善了网络。选项借用了录音里的词，是陷阱。

C.why: “Il faut des lieux où les gens se croisent”（需要有让人们碰面的地方）。结合前一句，远程办公的好处要靠见面场所才能实现。

D.why: 原文意思相反：“Des familles s'installent”（有家庭搬过来）。
